sources.snippet: Exercise 1: Explore SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct Objective: Get familiar with the SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct model and evaluate the model using a sample from the dataset. Environment Setup You need a GPU with at least 8GB VRAM for training. CPU/MPS can run formatting and dataset exploration, but training larger models will likely fail.
